leadText:
Ash's house is where Ash Ketchum lives with his mother Delia, and their shared Mimey reside in. The house is located in Pallet Town in the Kanto region.

After turning ten years old and obtaining his Pokémon Trainer's license, Ash departed from home to embark on his Pokémon journey. Due to Ash being on the road for long periods of time, Delia lived at the house alone until the events of It's Mr. Mime Time when Mimey was by Ash and left to reside with Delia, where it helps with cleaning and vacuuming the house. The house is where Ash returns to after the end of each journey, and very rarely during the middle of his journey as depicted from It's Mr. Mime Time to Bad To The Bone, when Ash and spent a few months in Pallet Town (while occasionally traveling elsewhere in-between) in preparation for the Indigo Plateau Conference.

The house also been host for other guests besides the Ketchum family, such as , , , Tracey Sketchit, , , Professor Birch, , Goh, and Chloe.
